title: org.kde.PlasmaShell.evaluateScript should implicitly add a newline to the output of print()
line: Each print() in a Plasma desktop script now comes back on its own line instead of all run together.
explanation: ShellCorona::evaluateScript() wrote every print() and printError() message into one QTextStream buffer with no separator, so print("one"); print("two") came back over D-Bus (and in the Desktop Shell Scripting Console) as "onetwo". The messages are now collected in a list and joined with newlines; there is no trailing newline, so a single print() returns exactly the same text as before.

commits.message:
shell: separate print() outputs of evaluateScript with newlines

evaluateScript appended every print() and error message to the reply
with no separator, so successive prints came back run together. Collect
the messages instead and join them with newlines in the returned text.

BUG: 524520
